data.title: MISSION SUCCESS: Rocket Lab Launches 96th Electron Mission
data.description: Rocket Lab Corporation, a prominent player in the launch services and space systems industry, has achieved a successful launch of the most recent Earth-observation satellite for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) company, Synspective. The event took place in Mahia, New Zealand on September 19, 2026. Rocket Lab Corporation, listed on Nasdaq as RKLB, continues to showcase its expertise in deploying satellites into space, contributing to technological advancements. This latest launch marks another milestone for both Rocket Lab Corporation and Synspective in advancing SAR technology for various applications.
